package moba

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/lockstep"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/nettransport"
	kcp "github.com/xtaci/kcp-go/v5"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// arenaKCP 是真实 loopback KCP 的服务端一侧：固定测试凭据建立会话，输入经可靠通道，广播经 datagram，
// 追帧页与快照分块经可靠通道。
type arenaKCP struct {
	ctx      context.Context
	key      []byte
	listener *kcp.Listener
	server   *nettransport.KCPTransport
}

func newArenaKCP(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context) *arenaKCP {
	t.Helper()
	key := bytes.Repeat([]byte{7}, 32)
	crypt, err := nettransport.NewKCPAESGCM(key)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	listener, err := nettransport.ListenKCP("127.0.0.1:0", crypt, 10, 3)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { listener.Close() })
	server, err := nettransport.NewKCPTransport(nettransport.KCPTransportConfig{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { server.Close() })
	return &arenaKCP{ctx: ctx, key: key, listener: listener, server: server}
}

// connect 建立一条新会话：两端绑定同一 SessionID，客户端收到的 datagram 与可靠包按到达顺序进 inbox。
func (n *arenaKCP) connect(t *testing.T, id nettransport.SessionID) (*nettransport.KCPTransport, chan []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := n.ctx
	inbox := make(chan []byte, 128)
	cipher, err := nettransport.NewKCPAESGCM(n.key)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	connection, err := nettransport.DialKCP(n.listener.Addr().String(), cipher, 10, 3)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = connection.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
	if _, err := connection.Write([]byte("moba-test")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = connection.SetWriteDeadline(time.Time{})
	accepted, err := n.listener.AcceptKCP()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = accepted.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
	if _, err := accepted.Read(make([]byte, 32)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = accepted.SetReadDeadline(time.Time{})
	if err := n.server.BindSession(id, accepted); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := n.server.RegisterSession(nettransport.SessionInfo{ID: id}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	client, err := nettransport.NewKCPTransport(nettransport.KCPTransportConfig{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { client.Close() })
	if err := client.BindSession(id, connection); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := client.RegisterSession(nettransport.SessionInfo{ID: id}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := client.BindDatagramHandler(id, func(_ nettransport.SessionID, raw []byte) {
		select {
		case inbox <- raw:
		case <-ctx.Done():
		}
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	go func() {
		for {
			page, err := client.ReceiveReliable(ctx, id)
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			select {
			case inbox <- page:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return
			}
		}
	}()
	return client, inbox
}

// 真实 loopback KCP：固定测试凭据建立会话，输入经可靠通道，广播经 datagram，追帧经可靠通道。
// 这是网络 / 模拟验收，不把固定绑定说成真实账号认证，也不据此声明跨机延迟或容量。
func TestMOBAFiveVFiveKCPClientsConvergeAfterCatchup(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	network := newArenaKCP(t, ctx)
	server := network.server
	clients := make([]*nettransport.KCPTransport, ArenaSeats)
	inboxes := make([]chan []byte, ArenaSeats)
	for i := range ArenaSeats {
		clients[i], inboxes[i] = network.connect(t, nettransport.SessionID(101+i))
	}
	seats := make([]lockstep.PlayerID, ArenaSeats)
	for i := range seats {
		seats[i] = lockstep.PlayerID(i + 1)
	}
	m, err := lockstep.NewMatch(lockstep.MatchConfig{Sequencer: lockstep.SequencerConfig{Players: seats, SubmitWindow: 8, MaxInputBytes: 4}, Datagrams: server, Reliable: server, CatchupBatchFrames: 16, CatchupSendWait: 100 * time.Millisecond})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer m.Close()
	for i := range ArenaSeats {
		if err := m.Attach(lockstep.PlayerID(i+1), nettransport.SessionID(101+i)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	send := func(i int, c lockstep.Command) {
		t.Helper()
		id := nettransport.SessionID(101 + i)
		raw, err := lockstep.EncodeCommand(c)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := clients[i].SendReliable(ctx, id, raw); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		received, err := server.ReceiveReliable(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		command, err := lockstep.DecodeCommand(received)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if command.Operation == lockstep.OpInput {
			_, err = DecodeArena(command.Payload)
			if err == nil {
				err = m.HandleCommand(id, command)
			}
		} else {
			err = m.HandleCommand(id, command)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	reference := NewArena(42)
	states := make([]*Arena, ArenaSeats)
	assemblers := make([]*lockstep.FrameAssembler, ArenaSeats)
	for i := range states {
		states[i] = NewArena(42)
		assemblers[i] = lockstep.NewFrameAssembler(128)
	}
	catchups := 0
	for id := lockstep.FrameID(1); id <= 120; id++ {
		for i := range ArenaSeats {
			send(i, lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpInput, Frame: id, Payload: arenaBot(id, i)})
		}
		frame, err := m.Tick(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := reference.Apply(frame); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for i := range ArenaSeats {
			for {
				var packet []byte
				select {
				case packet = <-inboxes[i]:
				case <-ctx.Done():
					t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
				}
				frames, err := lockstep.DecodeBroadcast(packet)
				if err != nil || len(frames) == 0 {
					t.Fatalf("network broadcast: %v", err)
				}
				latest := frames[len(frames)-1].ID
				// 刻意在真实网络接收后丢弃超过冗余深度的连续广播，必须靠可靠追帧恢复。
				if !(i == 0 && latest >= 3 && latest <= 8) {
					frames, err := assemblers[i].Ingest(packet)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					for _, f := range frames {
						if err := states[i].Apply(f); err != nil {
							t.Fatal(err)
						}
					}
				}
				if latest >= id {
					break
				}
			}
		}
		if id == 9 && assemblers[0].Gap() {
			send(0, lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpCatchup, Frame: assemblers[0].Next()})
			catchups++
		}
	}
	if catchups != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("catchup requests=%d", catchups)
	}
	for i, s := range states {
		if s.Digest() != reference.Digest() {
			t.Fatalf("KCP player %d diverged tick=%d/%d", i, s.Tick, reference.Tick)
		}
	}
}

// 长断线恢复：两名玩家（各属一队）断线 4 个历史窗口后换新 KCP 会话重连，照常请求从缺的第一帧追帧。
// 起点早已被裁掉；Match 配了服务器参考模拟的检查点（ArenaCheckpoints）作快照来源，Recovery 零值即 auto，
// 于是改发 Arena 检查点、从检查点帧 +1 续发历史页、追到头后接回实时广播。验收：两人各恢复一次、
// 两个等快照的会话共用一次取快照，局末十个客户端与服务器参考模拟同摘要。
// 没有快照来源时（catchup 模式）同一请求以 ErrCatchupUnservable 失败，客户端只能终止本场。
func TestMOBAFiveVFiveKCPClientsRecoverFromSnapshotAfterLongDisconnect(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	const (
		window       = lockstep.FrameID(lockstep.MinHistoryRetainFrames)
		checkpointK  = 16
		disconnectAt = lockstep.FrameID(40)
		reconnectAt  = disconnectAt + 4*window
		endAt        = reconnectAt + 64
	)
	network := newArenaKCP(t, ctx)
	server := network.server
	type seatClient struct {
		transport  *nettransport.KCPTransport
		inbox      chan []byte
		session    nettransport.SessionID
		assembler  *lockstep.FrameAssembler
		state      *Arena
		online     bool
		recovering bool
		restored   []lockstep.FrameID
	}
	players := make([]*seatClient, ArenaSeats)
	for i := range players {
		session := nettransport.SessionID(101 + i)
		transport, inbox := network.connect(t, session)
		players[i] = &seatClient{transport: transport, inbox: inbox, session: session, assembler: lockstep.NewFrameAssembler(128), state: NewArena(42), online: true}
	}
	seats := make([]lockstep.PlayerID, ArenaSeats)
	for i := range seats {
		seats[i] = lockstep.PlayerID(i + 1)
	}
	checkpoints := &ArenaCheckpoints{}
	m, err := lockstep.NewMatch(lockstep.MatchConfig{
		Sequencer: lockstep.SequencerConfig{Players: seats, SubmitWindow: 8, MaxInputBytes: 4}, Datagrams: server, Reliable: server,
		CatchupBatchFrames: 16, CatchupSendWait: 100 * time.Millisecond, HistoryRetainFrames: int(window),
		Snapshots: lockstep.SnapshotConfig{Provider: checkpoints},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer m.Close()
	for i, p := range players {
		if err := m.Attach(lockstep.PlayerID(i+1), p.session); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	send := func(i int, c lockstep.Command) {
		t.Helper()
		p := players[i]
		raw, err := lockstep.EncodeCommand(c)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := p.transport.SendReliable(ctx, p.session, raw); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		received, err := server.ReceiveReliable(ctx, p.session)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		command, err := lockstep.DecodeCommand(received)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if command.Operation == lockstep.OpInput {
			_, err = DecodeArena(command.Payload)
		}
		if err == nil {
			err = m.HandleCommand(p.session, command)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("player %d %v from frame %d: %v", i+1, command.Operation, command.Frame, err)
		}
	}
	// deliver 把一个下行包交给客户端：快照到齐后用 RestoreArena 替换本地状态并核对状态 hash，再从快照帧 +1 续帧。
	deliver := func(i int, packet []byte) {
		t.Helper()
		p := players[i]
		delivery, err := p.assembler.Receive(packet)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("player %d: %v", i+1, err)
		}
		if s := delivery.Snapshot; s != nil {
			restored, err := RestoreArena(s.Data, 42)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !s.HasStateHash || restored.Hash() != s.StateHash || restored.Tick != s.Frame {
				t.Fatalf("player %d snapshot frame %d tick %d hash %d want %d", i+1, s.Frame, restored.Tick, restored.Hash(), s.StateHash)
			}
			p.state = restored
			p.restored = append(p.restored, s.Frame)
			p.assembler.ResumeAfterSnapshot(s.Frame)
		}
		for _, f := range delivery.Frames {
			if err := p.state.Apply(f); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("player %d frame %d: %v", i+1, f.ID, err)
			}
		}
	}
	latest := func(packet []byte) lockstep.FrameID {
		if lockstep.IsSnapshotChunk(packet) || lockstep.IsCatchupNotice(packet) {
			return 0
		}
		frames, err := lockstep.DecodeBroadcast(packet)
		if err != nil || len(frames) == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("network packet: %v", err)
		}
		return frames[len(frames)-1].ID
	}
	away := []int{1, 7}
	reference := NewArena(42)
	historyStart := lockstep.FrameID(0)
	for id := lockstep.FrameID(1); ; id++ {
		if id > MaxFrames-1 {
			t.Fatal("players did not recover before the arena time limit")
		}
		switch id {
		case disconnectAt + 1:
			for _, i := range away {
				p := players[i]
				m.DetachSession(lockstep.PlayerID(i+1), p.session)
				p.online = false
				_ = p.transport.Close()
				server.RemoveSession(p.session)
			}
		case reconnectAt:
			for _, i := range away {
				p := players[i]
				p.session = nettransport.SessionID(201 + i)
				p.transport, p.inbox = network.connect(t, p.session)
				if err := m.Attach(lockstep.PlayerID(i+1), p.session); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				p.online, p.recovering = true, true
				send(i, lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpCatchup, Frame: p.assembler.Next()})
			}
			if historyStart = m.History().FirstID(); players[away[0]].assembler.Next() >= historyStart {
				t.Fatalf("reconnect at %d: request %d is still inside the window starting at %d", id, players[away[0]].assembler.Next(), historyStart)
			}
		}
		// 恢复中的玩家还没回到当前局面，不提交输入（真实客户端同样先追上再操作）。
		for i, p := range players {
			if p.online && !p.recovering {
				send(i, lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpInput, Frame: id, Payload: arenaBot(id, i)})
			}
		}
		frame, err := m.Tick(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := reference.Apply(frame); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if frame.ID%checkpointK == 0 {
			checkpoints.Publish(reference)
		}
		recovering := false
		for i, p := range players {
			switch {
			case !p.online:
			case p.recovering:
				// 快照分块与历史页经可靠通道到达，非阻塞收取；追到当前帧后改回逐帧等待实时广播。
				for drained := false; !drained; {
					select {
					case packet := <-p.inbox:
						deliver(i, packet)
					default:
						drained = true
					}
				}
				if p.assembler.Next() > id && !p.assembler.SnapshotInProgress() {
					p.recovering = false
				} else {
					recovering = true
				}
			default:
				for {
					var packet []byte
					select {
					case packet = <-p.inbox:
					case <-ctx.Done():
						t.Fatalf("player %d waiting for frame %d: %v", i+1, id, ctx.Err())
					}
					deliver(i, packet)
					if latest(packet) >= id {
						break
					}
				}
				if p.assembler.Next() <= id {
					t.Fatalf("player %d has a gap at %d after live frame %d", i+1, p.assembler.Next(), id)
				}
			}
		}
		if id >= endAt && !recovering {
			break
		}
	}
	for _, i := range away {
		p := players[i]
		if len(p.restored) != 1 || p.restored[0]%checkpointK != 0 || p.restored[0] < reconnectAt-window {
			t.Fatalf("player %d restored from %v", i+1, p.restored)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("reconnected before frame %d asking from frame %d (history starts at %d); players %d and %d restored from checkpoints %v / %v; all ten match the reference at frame %d",
		reconnectAt, disconnectAt+1, historyStart, away[0]+1, away[1]+1, players[away[0]].restored, players[away[1]].restored, reference.Tick)
	if served := checkpoints.Served(); served != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint served %d times; two waiting sessions should share one fetch", served)
	}
	for i, p := range players {
		if p.state.Tick != reference.Tick || p.state.Digest() != reference.Digest() {
			t.Fatalf("KCP player %d diverged tick=%d/%d", i+1, p.state.Tick, reference.Tick)
		}
	}
}
